title: tc-contact-channels
description:
The ways to reach a person or an account – email, phone, messaging and address – each masked until revealed, with
its role, when it was last used and whether it's verified, Copy and the page's own actions.

channels.description: The contact points, in order; they're grouped by kind

states.description: Verification states' names and tones, merged over the defaults (verified, unverified, bounced, dormant, flagged)

kindLabels.description: The groups' names, merged over the defaults (Email, Phone, Messaging, Address)

actions.description: Actions added to every row after Copy, e.g. [{ id: "message", label: "Message" }]

masked.description: Masks values until revealed; set false to show them in full

revealed.description: The ids whose values are shown. Changed by the user unless a tc-revealed-change listener calls preventDefault()

locale.description: The language for dates, e.g. "en-GB"; by default the browser's

value.description: The address, number, handle or postal address

lastUsed.description: When it was last used, as epoch ms

state.description: A key of `states`: verified, unverified, bounced, dormant, flagged, or one of the page's own

note.description: One quiet line: "Bounced twice in May"

ContactTone.description: The tone a verification state is drawn in

ContactAction.description: An action the page adds to every row
